# @egose/shadcn-theme

> shadcn/ui-style React component theme. Deep-import only — every module is its own subpath. Pure utilities are server-safe; interactive modules declare `"use client"`.

Public subpaths are condition-aware: ESM import uses `.mjs` + `.d.mts`; CommonJS require uses `.js` + `.d.ts`. Never import physical files from the installed package.

## Install

```
npm i @egose/shadcn-theme react react-dom react-hook-form sonner
```

Peers: react ^18.3.1 || ^19.0.0 · react-dom ^18.3.1 || ^19.0.0 · react-hook-form ^7.54.2 · sonner ^2.0.7. Tailwind CSS v4 is recommended consumer-side setup, not a package peer.

## Subpath map

### UI primitives — `@egose/shadcn-theme/components/ui/<name>`

`accordion` · `alert` · `alert-dialog` · `aspect-ratio` · `avatar` · `badge` · `basic-alert` · `breadcrumb` · `button` · `button-group` · `calendar` · `card` · `carousel` · `checkbox` · `collapsible` · `combobox` · `command` · `context-menu` · `copy-button` · `dialog` · `direction` · `drawer` · `dropdown-menu` · `empty` · `field` · `hover-card` · `input` · `input-group` · `input-otp` · `item` · `kbd` · `label` · `menubar` · `multi-select` · `native-select` · `navigation-menu` · `pagination` · `popover` · `progress` · `radio-group` · `resizable` · `scroll-area` · `scroll-shadow` · `select` · `separator` · `sheet` · `sidebar` · `skeleton` · `slider` · `sonner` · `spinner` · `switch` · `table` · `tabs` · `tag-picker` · `textarea` · `toggle` · `toggle-group` · `tooltip` · `unstyled-button` · `extension/file-input`

### Form fields (react-hook-form) — `@egose/shadcn-theme/components/form/<name>`

`checkbox` · `date-picker` · `date-range-picker` · `error` · `hook-checkbox` · `hook-date-picker` · `hook-multi-select` · `hook-native-select` · `hook-searchable-select` · `hook-select` · `hook-tag-picker` · `hook-text-input` · `hook-textarea` · `hook-time-input` · `multi-select` · `native-select` · `searchable-select` · `select` · `tag-picker` · `text-input` · `textarea` · `time-input` · `types`

### Widgets — `@egose/shadcn-theme/components/widgets/<name>`

- `action-menu` → `ActionMenu`, `ActionMenuProps`, `ActionMenuItem`
- `confirmation-dialog` → `ConfirmationDialog`, `ConfirmationDialogArgs`, `ConfirmationDialogResult`
- `content-sidebar` → `ContentSidebar`, `ContentSidebarProps`, `ContentSidebarItem`
- `dialog-manager` (and `dialog-manager/*`): `DialogManagerProvider`, `useDialog`, `createTypedDialog`, `DialogContext`, `DialogCancellationError`, `DialogProps`, `TypedDialogComponent`
- `image-preview-dialog` → `ImagePreviewDialog`, `ImagePreviewDialogArgs`
- `page-header` → `PageHeader`, `PageHeaderProps`
- `text-input-dialog` → `TextInputDialog`, `TextInputDialogArgs`, `TextInputDialogResult`

### Hooks — `@egose/shadcn-theme/hooks/<name>`

- `use-clipboard` → `useClipboard({ timeout? })` → `{ copied, copy, error }`
  - Latest-request success clears error and restarts the copied reset timer (default 2000ms); latest failure clears copied, cancels the timer, and sets error. Pending writes retain prior feedback until settlement/timer expiry. Stale completions are ignored; unmount cancels the timer and ignores pending completions.
- `use-debounced-value` → `useDebouncedValue(value, delay)`
- `use-mobile` → `useIsMobile()` → `boolean`

### Utils — `@egose/shadcn-theme/utils/<name>`

- `ui` → `cn(...inputs: ClassValue[])` (clsx + tailwind-merge)
- `date` → `isEqualDate`, `isEqualDates`
- `time` → `convertToHours(value, asNumber?)` (parses `90m`, `1.5h`, `3600s`, bare numbers)

### Layouts — `@egose/shadcn-theme/layouts/<name>`

- `simple` (and `simple/*`): `SimpleLayout` (default) · `SimpleLayoutProps`, `MenuItem`, `UserMenuSection` (types)
- `sidebar1` (and `sidebar1/*`): `SidebarLayout` (default) · `useLayoutHeader` · `ISidebarData`, `ISidebarContext`, `INavUser`, `INavUserMenuItem`, `INavMenu`, `IMenuItem`, `IMenuSubItem`, `INavContext` (types) · `AppSidebar`, `NavUser`, `NavMenus`, `ContextSwitcher`, `ThemeSwitcher`, `LinkPlaceholder`

## Canonical patterns

```tsx
"use client";

import { Button } from "@egose/shadcn-theme/components/ui/button";
import { FormTextInput } from "@egose/shadcn-theme/components/form/text-input";
import { useClipboard } from "@egose/shadcn-theme/hooks/use-clipboard";
import { cn } from "@egose/shadcn-theme/utils/ui";
import SimpleLayout from "@egose/shadcn-theme/layouts/simple";
import Link from "next/link";

export function Demo() {
  const { copy, copied } = useClipboard();
  return (
    <SimpleLayout aslink={Link} left={{ menus: [{ label: "Home", link: "/" }] }}>
      <Button variant="primary" loading={copied} onClick={() => copy("hi")}>
        {copied ? "Copied" : "Copy"}
      </Button>
      <FormTextInput name="title" label="Title" required />
    </SimpleLayout>
  );
}
```

Promise-based dialog flow:

```tsx
"use client";
import { DialogManagerProvider, useDialog, createTypedDialog } from "@egose/shadcn-theme/components/widgets/dialog-manager";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogFooter } from "@egose/shadcn-theme/components/ui/dialog";
import { Button } from "@egose/shadcn-theme/components/ui/button";

const ConfirmDialog = createTypedDialog<{ title: string }, boolean>(
  ({ open, args, onClose }) => (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && onClose(false)}>
      <DialogContent>
        {args.title}
        <DialogFooter>
          <Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => onClose(false)}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button variant="danger" onClick={() => onClose(true)}>Confirm</Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  ),
);

// inside a component under <DialogManagerProvider>:
// const ok = await openDialog(ConfirmDialog, { title: "Delete?" });
// If the owning provider unmounts first, the promise rejects with DialogCancellationError.
```

## Notable conventions

- `utils/ui`, `utils/date`, and `utils/time` are safe to call from Server Components. Hook, context, interactive, and browser-dependent entries declare `"use client"` in ESM and CommonJS.
- The `components/widgets/dialog-manager` barrel is a client entry. A Server Component may render `DialogManagerProvider`; call `useDialog` and pass event callbacks only from your own client component.
- `Button` accepts `variant`, `size`, `appearance`, `loading`, `icon`, `iconPosition`. Combine semantic colors (including `action`) with `solid`, `outline`, `outline-filled`, `ghost`, or `link` appearances (`VariantStyleType`). Legacy `link`/`ghost` variants remain supported.
- Native `Button` elements are disabled when `loading` or `disabled` is true; `disabled={false}` cannot override loading. After loading, they re-enable only when `disabled` is false or omitted.
- `buttonVariants` includes all appearance rules; use `cn(buttonVariants({ variant: 'success', appearance: 'outline' }), className)` for custom hosts. Consumer `className` overrides are merged last; loading spinners inherit the button text color.
- Define palettes with Tailwind v4 `@theme inline` mappings to CSS variables for scoped light/dark or brand themes. CSS tokens customize existing variant names, not the typed variant list. See README's Button colors and appearances section.
- Text-input wrappers compose with `react-hook-form` via `inputProps={{ ...register('name', rules) }}`. Selection fields use `value`/`onChange` or their `hook-*` wrappers. `HookFormRules<T>` (in `components/form/types`) is the safe `RegisterOptions` subset.
- `FormSelect` (`components/form/select`) forwards `name`/`required`/`disabled` to Radix, contributing the selected value to enclosing-form `FormData` unless disabled. Use `value` for controlled selection or `defaultValue` for an initial uncontrolled selection.
- `FormSelect` and `FormSearchableSelect` associate labels with their focusable trigger via `id` (defaults to kebab-cased `name`; use unique IDs for repeated fields). Both accept strings or `{ value, label }` options.
- `FormSearchableSelect` (`components/form/searchable-select`) searches human labels and stable IDs, emitting the value, not the label. Values must be unique; labels may repeat. Selecting the same ID again emits `''` to clear; selection closes the popup. No matches show “No option found.” See README's Selection fields example.
- `FormMultiSelect` (`components/form/multi-select`) accepts string or `{ value, label }` options with unique values and controlled `value: string[]`. Preserves every selected ID in order across empty/partial option refreshes and user edits to other selections. Missing labels fall back to IDs and refresh when metadata arrives or changes. `onChange` requests user edits only; mount/option refreshes emit nothing. Update `value` to accept edits.
- `FormMultiSelect`'s visible `label` names and targets the actual search input. cmdk owns its final generated DOM ID even with an explicit/default `id`; the label follows the mounted input through its ref, preserving cmdk's internal label/ARIA/focus relationships and independent same-name fields. Use the input ref for programmatic focus.
- All three selection fields expose `onBlur?: () => void` for leaving the whole field after focus settles, including portalled content. Internal opening/search/selection/Escape and badge interaction do not touch the field while focus remains inside or returns to its trigger/input. `FormSelect`/`FormSearchableSelect` forward `ref` to `HTMLButtonElement`; `FormMultiSelect` forwards to `HTMLInputElement`, using React 18/19-compatible `forwardRef`.
- `HookFormSelect`, `HookFormSearchableSelect`, and `HookFormMultiSelect` (the corresponding `components/form/hook-*` paths) connect RHF blur/ref for `mode: 'onBlur'`, touched state, `setFocus`, and invalid-submit focus. Optional `onBlur` is composed after RHF's handler. Use `FormProvider`, validation `rules`, and `useForm` defaults of `''` or `[]`. See README's Selection validation and focus example.
- `MultiSelectorInput` (`components/ui/multi-select`) forwards its actual input ref and composes native blur/focus/click/value-change handlers with internal behavior. Its native `onBlur` receives an event; the form-level composite callback takes no arguments. Multi-select keeps/restores input focus for popup and badge interactions, preserving outside focus on dismissal.
- Layout `aslink` prop is required — pass your router's `Link` (works for both `to=` and `href=` APIs).
- `SimpleLayout` / `SimpleLayoutProps` (`layouts/simple`) expose `loading?: boolean` and `loadingContent?: React.ReactNode`. Loading sets main `aria-busy="true"` and renders the slot; null/undefined use the default `role="status"` text “Loading…”. Custom/localized slots replace the whole status: supply `role="status"` with meaningful text or an accessible name (`aria-label`/`aria-labelledby`) for non-text feedback, not a decorative spinner alone. False/omitted loading sets main `aria-busy="false"` and renders children. Children unmount during loading and mount fresh afterward (local form state resets); the loading slot unmounts on completion. Keep persistent drafts above the layout. Header/footer/navigation remain mounted and usable. See README's Simple layout loading example.
- `NavMenus` / `IMenuItem` / `IMenuSubItem` (`layouts/sidebar1/nav-menus`, under `SidebarProvider` and `TooltipProvider`; also `SidebarLayout`'s `data.menus`): a child calls its own `onClick(child.title)`, falling back to the parent's handler only when absent; never both. This corrects parent-only dispatch. URL items keep `aslink` navigation with both `href`/`to`; custom links must forward `onClick`. All leaf activations close the mobile sidebar, including no-handler items. Group toggles only expand/collapse and keep mobile open. Action-only hosts and toggles are non-submit buttons. See README's Sidebar navigation actions contract.
- `ContextSwitcher` / `INavContext` (`layouts/sidebar1/context-switcher`, under `SidebarProvider`; also `SidebarLayout`'s `data.context.items` / `data.events.contextSelect`): the first `active: true` item is authoritative on every render, including empty-to-loaded. `onContextSelected` requests changes with the current item; the parent accepts by updating active flags. No optimistic label change, even without a callback. With no active item, selection is local by unique stable `name`, initially the first item. Current metadata is always used; removal remembers the first-item fallback, empty resets/renders nothing, and clearing active flags retains the last displayed name if present. Mount/refresh/fallback emit no callbacks; user reselect does. This corrects stale workspace labels; consumers own data switching, persistence, and authorization. See README's Sidebar workspace context selection contract.
- `cn` is the single point for class composition; pass `classNames` slots on layouts/form-fields to extend (never override) defaults.
